result.topic_en: Euler completes the vibration equations for the two portions EL and LF of a rod, then in §51 derives a second solution from the other factor, tan(ω/2) = (e^ω − 1)/(1 + e^ω), showing each half can vibrate as if fixed at the ends and clamped at L, giving tones two octaves higher than case five.

Quia igitur omnes euanefcunt praeter $\gamma$ et $\gamma'$, ac praeterea eft $\gamma' = -\gamma$, fi ponamus $\gamma = 1$ erit $\gamma' = -1$; pro portione E L igitur aequatio motum exprimens erit

$y = -C\,\text{fin.}\left(\zeta + t\,\frac{\omega\omega c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}\right)\,\text{fin.}\,u\omega,$
vbi eft $u = \frac{s}{a}$.

§. 51. Praeterea vero datur adhuc alia folutio ex altero factore oriunda, ex quo fit
$\text{tang.}\,\tfrac{1}{2}\omega = \frac{e^{\omega} - 1}{1 + e^{\omega}} = \frac{e^{\frac{1}{2}\omega} - e^{-\frac{1}{2}\omega}}{e^{\frac{1}{2}\omega} + e^{-\frac{1}{2}\omega}},$
qui valor congruit cum eo, qui fupra, cafu quinto, eft erutus: totum enim difcrimen in hoc confiftit, quod hic fit $\tfrac{1}{2}\omega$ quod ibi erat $\omega$, quemadmodum rei natura poftulat, quoniam hic vtriusque portionis longitudo tantum eft $\tfrac{1}{2}a$. Hinc ergo intelligimus, vtramque portionem E L et L F perinde contremifcere poffe ac fi vtraque in E et F ftylo fimpliciter effet fixa, in L vero firmiter prorfus infixa. Hic autem valores pro $\omega$ erunt $\frac{5\pi}{2}, \frac{9\pi}{2}, \frac{13\pi}{2}, \frac{17\pi}{2}, \frac{21\pi}{2}$, etc. ficque hinc foni orientur duabus octauis altiores quam cafu quinto. Hic igitur maxime notatu dignum contigit, quod ambas portiones E L et L F duplici modo contremifcere poffunt, altero, qui cum cafu fuperiore quarto, altero vero, qui cum cafu quinto congruit. items.quote: Hinc ergo intelligimus, vtramque portionem E L et L F perinde contremifcere poffe ac fi vtraque in E et F ftylo fimpliciter effet fixa, in L vero firmiter prorfus infixa.
items.english: Hence we understand that each portion EL and LF can vibrate just as if each were simply fixed by a pin at E and F, but firmly clamped at L.

items.quote: ficque hinc foni orientur duabus octauis altiores quam cafu quinto.
items.english: and thus the tones arising here are two octaves higher than in the fifth case.

items.quote: quod ambas portiones E L et L F duplici modo contremifcere poffunt, altero, qui cum cafu fuperiore quarto, altero vero, qui cum cafu quinto congruit.
items.english: that both portions EL and LF can vibrate in two ways, one agreeing with the fourth case above, the other with the fifth case.
